description: Election Commission - Declare that M. Dilan Kapila was Elected as Member of the No. 12 Wallambagala of Elpitiya Pradeshiyaa Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of a member, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the nomination and declaration of a new elected member through a political party's decision, which falls under electoral processes and matters related to local authority elections.
